title: Concept: Podfile entry with no version requirement
description: Podfile declares a pod declared without a requirement, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: CocoaPods resolves the newest matching pod, so a release published after review installs unchanged.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Podfile (cocoapods).
risk: CocoaPods resolves the newest matching pod, so a release published after review installs unchanged.
